back_translation: The people who walk in darkness have seen a great light; the light has shone down upon those who dwell in the land of the shadow of death.
You have multiplied that nation; You have increased their joy. They rejoice before Your face like the joy at harvest time, like men rejoicing when dividing the spoil they have taken.
For the heavy yoke that burdened them, the carrying-bar on their shoulder, and the club of their oppressor, You have shattered as in the day of Midian.
For every pair of soldier's boots that stamped in the battle, and every cloak rolled in blood, will be burned as fuel for the fire.

For a child has been born for us; a son has been given to us, and the rule will be upon his shoulder. And they will proclaim his name: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Eternal Father, Prince of Peace.

His rule will increase without end, and peace will never cease, over the throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish it and uphold it with justice and with righteousness, from now on and forever. The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this.
The Sovereign Master has sent a word against Jacob, and it has fallen upon Israel.
And all the people will know it — Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria — who say with pride and with an arrogant heart:
"The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with dressed stone; the sycamore-figs have been cut down, but we will plant cedars in their place."
But the LORD has raised up the adversaries of Rezin against them and stirred up their enemies —
Aram from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they devoured Israel with a wide-open mouth. Even so, His wrath has not turned back, and His hand is still stretched out.
Yet the people did not turn back to Him who struck them, and they did not seek the LORD of Hosts.
So the LORD cut off from Israel head and tail, both palm frond and reed, in a single day.
The elder and the honored man — he is the head; and the prophet who teaches falsehood — he is the tail.
For the guides of this people lead them astray, and those who are led are swallowed up.

Therefore the Sovereign Master will not rejoice over their young men, and will not show mercy to their fatherless children and their widows; for everyone is godless and does evil, and every mouth speaks moral folly. Even so, His wrath has not turned back, and His hand is still stretched out.
For wickedness burns like a fire; it devours the briers and thornbushes; it sets the dense thickets of the forest ablaze, and they roll upward in a dark column of smoke.
The land is scorched by the wrath of the LORD of Hosts, and the people have become like fuel for the fire; no one spares the life of his brother.
They snatch and eat on the right and are still hungry; they devour on the left and are not satisfied. Each one gnaws the flesh of his own arm.
Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim devours Manasseh; then together they turn against Judah. Even so, His wrath has not turned back, and His hand is still stretched out.
